what: runs sharing one RTX A6000 under `woof multi-run --runs-per-gpu N [--mps|--no-mps]`, every run from one prepared bundle (module woof.prepared_single_domain_forecast, --io-mode history); per-run slowdown = the run's mean step wall (step_wall_seconds from progress.jsonl, the first 5 steps dropped) over the same mean alone
code: feat/runtime-estimate 3cf49df54 (forecast code identical to main dc091b436)

contention.method: nvidia-smi utilization, memory and compute apps, and /proc/loadavg, every 5 s (each case's contention.log)
contention.card: no compute process other than the case's own runs (and the MPS control server with MPS on) in any sample
contention.host: load average 4.8 to 20.5 from other users' work

large.configuration: woof domain --point 14.6,121 --root-dx 3 --clock fixed --source gfs --cycle 2026-11-07T00: 450 x 360 x 49 (162,000 columns), dx 3 km, dt 7.5 s; Morrison, RTE+RRTMGP, YSU, Noah, no cumulus

rows.note: two attempts; 1 then 2 of the 4 runs exited in about 3.7 s with GPUPreflightError: unknown pmon type 'M+C'; the first attempt's three survivors ran 0.5979 s/step (a replicate of three)

serial.plan: four one-run multi-run plans in sequence

small.configuration: woof domain --point 14.6,121 --root-dx 12 --point-extent-km 1800 --clock fixed --source gfs --cycle 2026-11-07T00 --hours 6: 150 x 120 x 49 (18,000 columns), dx 12 km, dt 30 s, same suite

findings: Without MPS each run ran slower than its share of the card (2.24x for two, 4.5x for four, 9.05x for eight), at 18,000 and at 162,000 columns: the card time-slices the contexts and packing gains only the overlap of the runs' start-up (4 large runs: 484.1 s packed against 489.6 s one at a time).

MPS cut the per-run step time 13 % at two and at three large runs (0.3976 against 0.4559 s, 0.5962 against 0.6853 s) and 22 % at two small runs (0.0480 against 0.06135 s); the small three- and five-run MPS rows have no matching no-MPS count (compared with the interpolated off rows, about 25 %).
woof.supervisor's GPU preflight fails closed on the pmon type an MPS client reports ('M+C'): with three or more runs launched under --mps, some runs exited before their first step.
